label: Updated at 8 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Scottie Scheffler Misses Cut
items.text: Scottie Scheffler missed the cut at the Genesis Scottish Open for the first time since 2022, finishing level par and ending his 78-cut streak as Rory McIlroy moves near the lead at 9-under.

items.headline: Jordan Smith Leads Scottish Open
items.text: Jordan Smith posted rounds of 68-63 to reach 9-under and shares the Genesis Scottish Open lead with Tom Kim and Rory McIlroy at The Renaissance Club heading into moving day.

items.headline: Lucas Glover Leads ISCO Championship
items.text: Lucas Glover leads the ISCO Championship at 13-under par, two shots ahead of Chan Kim and Steven Fisk at 11-under, aiming for a PGA Tour title and big points as summer stretch continues.
